description: Clone of exp108 (best Tiny-path result, 1.7832) replacing TinyMultiHeadLut with standard MultiHeadLut(n_alternatives=1, smooth_mode=True, return_per_table_outputs=True) + external SparseScatter (with balanced coverage indices). Goal: isolate whether the Tiny vs MHLut gap (exp104 1.7722 vs exp100 1.7144) is from smooth_mode or from n_alternatives. Architecture identical to exp108: E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip residual, linear unembedder, balanced scatter, n_sparse=1, nap=10, qk/v tph=768, out tph=4096.
